title: The Audrey phone messages

tellings.quote: most people don't know there was 80 over 80 phone calls, Audrey phone calls to all sorts of people.

plain: Between about 2000 and 2019, according to Grant Cameron, a guest who researches the subject, "over 80" phone calls known as the Audrey calls went out to "all sorts of people", and most people have never heard of them. Cameron passes this on from others, and he names Stan Romanek, Paola Harris and Timothy Taylor in connection with it, though he says nothing here about who or what Audrey was or what the calls said.
